subject.title: Feature: Support custom anthropic_beta flags in Bedrock model config

question: Should Bedrock expose a broad `additionalModelRequestFields`/`providerFields` merge contract, a narrower typed `anthropicBeta` option, or keep Anthropic beta flags internal?
rationale: The missing path is source-proven, but adding provider request-body config expands a public provider contract and OpenClaw's config policy requires maintainer intent before choosing that surface.

options.title: Add typed Bedrock beta config
options.body: Expose a Bedrock-owned `anthropicBeta` string-list option that merges and deduplicates with provider-generated betas while avoiding arbitrary request-body passthrough.

options.title: Add broad request-field merge contract
options.body: Expose schema-validated `additionalModelRequestFields` or `providerFields` for Bedrock and document merge precedence, safety boundaries, and unsupported prompt-management interactions.

options.title: Keep beta flags internal
options.body: Decline custom beta config and require first-class provider support for each Bedrock beta feature as it becomes needed.

recommendation.title: Add typed Bedrock beta config
recommendation.body: Expose a Bedrock-owned `anthropicBeta` string-list option that merges and deduplicates with provider-generated betas while avoiding arbitrary request-body passthrough.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Bedrock provider runtime/options work makes this the closest observed owner for the schema and request-shaping decision.
